BEHIND THE VOICE / 윤미래

Meet Yoon Mirae.

Yoon Mirae is a rapper and singer, also known as Tasha or T. Her music spans hip-hop, R&B and drama soundtracks, with a spare acoustic setting here on “Breath”.

She debuted with Uptown in 1997, performed in the duo Tashannie, and began her solo career with As Time Goes By in 2001. At the 2008 Korean Music Awards, her album t 3 YOONMIRAE won Best R&B & Soul Album and “What’s Up! Mr. Good Stuff” won Best R&B & Soul Song.
